scope: English original base main rulebook v1.2, base glossary, official base FAQ; source packet supplemented during audit with official publisher Icon Overview. Solo and Marine Worlds excluded. Original German publisher Spielzene component photograph used only for obscured Animals II numeral cells.
summary: Existing rules claims closely match the English base packet. Addition of the official Icon Overview exposes material omissions in interactive ability procedures, plus local missing effect/icon instructions. No edits made to snapshot.

source_review.excluded_evidence_not_read: Questions/answer keys/readers/grades/prior summaries/audit or repair histories and other QA evidence were not read. Permitted followup-source-report used for photo provenance only.
source_review.limitation: This is preliminary supporting audit; no claim to be the separate final-only audit.

findings.claim: Hypnosis does not restrict the chosen target Action card to slots 1, 2, or 3.
source_references: Official Icon Overview p.2, Hypnosis bullet 2
findings.source_rule: Perform one action from card slot 1, 2, or 3 of the affected player.
findings.impact: The current standalone Hypnosis procedure permits interpreting any targeted Action card as legal, including powerful slots 4 and 5.
findings.recommended_correction: Specify that the targeted Action card must be in slot 1, 2, or 3.

findings.claim: The interactive-ability procedures omit who receives Venom and Constriction, how track leads set Constriction token count, and the Pilfering 1 versus Pilfering 2 target mapping.
source_references: Official Icon Overview p.2, Venom, Constriction, Pilfering
Base glossary pp.2–3, five-appeal eligibility and tie/self-target rules
findings.source_rule: Venom affects all zoos with higher appeal than yours. Constriction affects all zoos ahead on appeal and/or conservation; one token per track on which each affected zoo is ahead, placed in highest slots. Pilfering 1 targets highest appeal; Pilfering 2 targets highest appeal and most conservation points. Eligibility, self-target, ties, and Quarantine Lab exceptions continue to apply.
findings.impact: The summary explains token placement and consequences but does not let a reader identify recipients or allocate the correct number of tokens; Pilfering 2 can take from two qualifying targets, including twice from the same player.
findings.recommended_correction: Add the three targeting definitions and relate Constriction token count to the number of tracks ahead.

findings.claim: Paid Sponsor effects do not explicitly state that the Sponsors Action card remains in its current slot.
source_references: Official Icon Overview p.2, top paid-Sponsor icon box
Base glossary p.7, card 253 Okapi Stable
Official FAQ p.1, paid Sponsor bonus from hand only
findings.source_rule: Play a Sponsor from hand for money equal to level, meet normal conditions, and leave the Sponsors Action card in its same slot; this effect does not move it.
findings.impact: Existing text gets hand restriction, cost, and conditions right, but the action-row consequence is absent and can be confused with executing a Sponsors action.
findings.recommended_correction: Add that a paid Sponsor effect does not execute/move the Sponsors Action card.

findings.claim: The general ability reference lacks Perception X and omits Pouch X count/payout and Sunbathing X general sale payout.
source_references: Official Icon Overview p.2, Pouch X, Perception X, Sunbathing X
Base glossary p.3, Pouch and Sunbathing discard clarifications
findings.source_rule: Pouch X: tuck up to X hand cards for two appeal each. Perception X: draw X deck cards, keep half, discard the rest. Sunbathing X: sell up to X hand cards for four money each, discarding sold cards.
findings.impact: Pouch and Sunbathing currently give only follow-up clarifications. Card 249 gives the Perception-2 instance and card 250 gives the Sunbathing-2 instance, but neither states the general ability procedure. The opening caveat to follow printed card amounts reduces the severity.
findings.recommended_correction: Add concise general procedures for these three abilities.

findings.claim: The condition reference omits the max-25-appeal condition and the different partner-zoo requirement on Sponsor cards.
source_references: Official Icon Overview p.1, condition column; p.2, appeal-25 reminder
findings.source_rule: A max.25 flag requires current appeal at most 25 when playing the card. A partner-zoo condition requires the same continent on an Animal card but any continent on a Sponsor card.
findings.impact: The summary requires satisfying conditions but leaves these two printed-condition meanings undefined. This is a local eligibility gap rather than an incorrect existing statement.
findings.recommended_correction: Define the max-25 play condition and the Sponsor-versus-Animal partner-zoo condition.

findings.claim: The summary does not define the immediate standard-enclosure bonus icon as a one-time free size-2 or size-3 enclosure.
source_references: Official Icon Overview p.1, middle column enclosure bonus icons
findings.source_rule: Immediately build the indicated size-2 or size-3 standard enclosure once for free, following applicable placement and upgrade restrictions.
findings.impact: Generic placement-bonus timing and free-building restrictions are present, but the effect represented by these common printed bonus icons is not stated.
findings.recommended_correction: Add a short bonus-icon key for the free indicated-size enclosure (and identify other action/build icons as needed).
